title: Mini-CPT tests on sand-kaolinite mixtures contaminated with crude oil
institution: Amirkabir University of Technology, Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
related_publication: Ghalenooee, M. (2019). Using CPT data in contaminated soil behavior classification. MSc thesis, Amirkabir University of Technology.

equipment.drive: hydraulic jack with three-phase motor and LS iG5A inverter
equipment.sensor_calibration_note: Calibration factors and dates were not recorded in the thesis.

procedure.compaction_standard: ASTM D698 (standard Proctor), used to find the optimum moisture content
procedure.sample_preparation: mixed at target moisture and oil content, stored 24 h in double plastic bags out of sunlight, compacted in the chamber in 5 cm layers with a wooden tamper, layer height checked at four corners

processing.raw_data_source: Excel workbooks embedded in the thesis .docx, extracted by src/extract_raw.py
processing.conversion_note: The thesis does not document how forces were converted to the qc and fs values in its Table 5-2; they cannot be reproduced from the raw forces.
